Dinner

Crispy Bang Bang Chicken Tenders

Crunchy cornflake-coated tenders with a creamy, sweet-heat yogurt dip. Quick to make in the air fryer and portioned as three tenders per serving.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
25 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
9

Ingredients

  • 300 g chicken tenders (about 6)
  • 1 egg, whisked
  • 30 g flour
  • 50 g cornflakes, crushed
  • 1 tsp garlic powder + 1 tsp onion powder
  • Salt and pepper
  • 10 sprays cooking oil
  • Bang bang sauce: 100 g 0% Greek yogurt, 30 g sweet chilli sauce, 1 tsp sriracha and 20 g honey
  • Extra sweet chilli sauce: 5 g per tender (about 30 g total)

Amounts are scaled from 2 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Heat the air fryer to 400°F (200°C). Season the chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder and onion powder.
  2. Set out three shallow bowls: flour, whisked egg, and crushed cornflakes.
  3. Coat each tender in flour, dip in egg, then press into the cornflakes until covered.
  4. Arrange in the air fryer basket in a single layer. Spray with the cooking oil and air-fry for 15 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp and 165°F (74°C) inside.
  5. While the chicken cooks, stir together the Greek yogurt, 30 g sweet chilli sauce, sriracha and honey.
  6. Spread 5 g extra sweet chilli sauce over each tender, then serve with the bang bang dip.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
